Quotation from President George W. Bush: First of all, my presence here shows it's never too late to come to Graceland. Laura and I are—we've known Elvis Presley since we were growing up. He's obviously a major part of our music history. He had an international reputation. His reputation was so strong that he attracted the attention of the now Prime Minister of Japan....
Quotation from Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi: It's like a dream.... My dream came true. Thank you very much....
